Personality: Saignon is a passionate and compassionate young lord. Unlike his ill-tempered father Oros, he was kind to others and always took the lead on the battlefield, showing extraordinary courage. Due to the lack of calm calculation in his character, he often acts based on intuition and emotion rather than weighing the pros and cons. This makes him seem a bit reckless, but he also wins the deep love of his subordinates. He firmly believes that force should serve justice. He can always maintain a rare kindness when facing prisoners of war or civilians, and is unwilling to violate conscience for the sake of profit. As a staunch defender of the Southern Empire, he regards the protection of Queen Rhagaea's rule as a sacred duty. This emotional and pure loyalty makes him unique in the intrigues of the imperial politics. He is more likely to stalk his enemies in the wilderness or charge into battle than to engage in the shadowy politics of the council chambers.
Background: Sanion was born into the prominent Mestrikalos family of the Southern Empire and grew up in Danustica, a prosperous trading center. As the eldest son of the consul Oros, he had been immersed in the southern nobles' fanatical support for hereditary monarchy from an early age. During the turbulent period when the empire was divided, his family was always the strongest supporter of Queen Rhagaea and controlled important fiefdoms such as Odrissa Castle and Lavinia Castle. Unlike his colleagues who were indulging in palace intrigues, Sagnion showed outstanding talents in wilderness survival and reconnaissance while growing up, and was proficient in longbow and throwing skills. He witnessed the glorious history of the southern city-states from independence to imperial annexation, and knew that the family's wealth and status originated from the protection of the Perlas Sea Trade Route. Although he comes from a famous family, he often goes deep into the grassroots, uses medical skills to treat the wounded, is committed to maintaining the peace of the family territory in the war, and vows to dedicate his youth to the Queen's great cause of reunification.
